alkylation reagent: SDS buffer (2% SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 0.5 mM EDTA, 75 mM NaCl, 10 mM DTT, 40 mM CAA final concentration)
alkylation concentration: SDS buffer (2% SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 0.5 mM EDTA, 75 mM NaCl, 10 mM DTT, 40 mM CAA final concentration)
cleavage agent: following digest with sequence-grade trypsin (Promega GmbH, Walldorf, Germany) and lysyl endopeptidase (LysC, FUJIFILM Wako Pure Chemical Corporation)
enrichment method: Subsequently, single-pot, solid-phase-enhanced sample preparation (SP3 cleanup) was performed.
instrument: Separated peptides were analyzed on an Orbitrap Q Exactive HF-X mass spectrometer
labeling: Match between runs, label-free quantification, and iBAQ algorithms were applied.
ptm: Oxidation (M) variable; N-terminal acetylation variable; deamidation (N, Q) variable; carbamidomethyl (C) fixed
Oxidation (M), N-terminal acetylation, and deamidation (N, Q) were set as variable modifications, and carbamidomethyl (C) was set as fixed modification.
reduction reagent: SDS buffer (2% SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 0.5 mM EDTA, 75 mM NaCl, 10 mM DTT, 40 mM CAA final concentration)
reduction concentration: SDS buffer (2% SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 0.5 mM EDTA, 75 mM NaCl, 10 mM DTT, 40 mM CAA final concentration)
